name: ERF Optimization with SVO Priors
aliases: Hierarchical Optimization for Explicit Radiance Field Reconstruction
definition: Iterative scene reconstruction from scratch using SGD and importance pixel sampling in a coarse-to-fine manner. It compares input images against differentiable renderings and updates the model according to model loss and gradients.
summary: ERF Optimization with SVO Priors reconstructs scenes using explicit sparse voxel octrees, distinguished by SVO priors and tanh constraints that stabilize optimization and prevent implausible geometry.
